title: Nick Fury Will Be Back in a Future Avengers Movie
summary:
Samuel L. Jackson plays Nick Fury in Marvel movies. Nick Fury is the super-agent who first brought the Avengers together as a team.

The next big Avengers movie is called "Avengers: Doomsday." It has lots of heroes, like Captain America and Thor. But Nick Fury will not be in it.

Good news for Fury fans! In an interview, Jackson said he will be in the movie after that one. It is called "Avengers: Secret Wars." It is planned to come out on December 17, 2027. When asked what it is about, Jackson said, "I have no idea."

The name "Secret Wars" comes from a Marvel comic from 1984 and 1985. In that story, a powerful being sends heroes and villains to a planet called Battleworld. They are told to fight, and the winner gets a wish. It is like a giant answer to the question, "Who would win in a fight?"
why_it_matters: Kids who love superhero movies can look forward to seeing Nick Fury again.
